conceptZh: 布忍者偷偷搬兩根鼓棒想排成「二」，棒子卻自己滑進位置，忍者還以為沒人看見。
morph: a short bar above a long bar
creativeAngle: 忍者躲得不好，鼓棒反而自己排好。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a soft powder-blue stage with a cream floor; the glyph is bold emerald-green 二, a shorter bar above a longer bar with a clear gap between them. A tiny felt ninja in a dark-red scarf tiptoes in at right. The Traditional Chinese glyph 二 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the ninja drags in two bright drumsticks on tiptoe, one clatters, and he freezes behind a thin pole that hides nothing; the first 二 is spoken as the clatter hits. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): the sticks wriggle out of his grip and slide on their own into a short bar above a long bar; the ninja does a double-take; the second 二 is spoken as the lower bar clicks in. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): he tears a page from a toy calendar with a tiny snowman picture and holds it overhead; 二月 is spoken as the snowman pops out of the page (a picture only, no readable text). From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 二 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the ninja bows to the glyph, then tries to tiptoe away in plain sight; the glyph is still. Narration (off-screen only, Taiwanese Mandarin, unhurried, every tone clear, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「二、二、二月」, read as ㄦˋ、ㄦˋ、ㄦˋ ㄩㄝˋ. Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.4s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only felt scuffs, wooden clacks and a soft pop, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.
